title: The forgotten room
goals: Every piece of thread ends up in your hands.
starting_code:
# Send {familiar} with `go_to` to the first corner.

# With `go_to`, to the second.

# With `go_to`, up into the room.

# For each piece of thread `find_all` finds, send {familiar} to it with `go_to`.
# There, have it pick the piece up with `pick_up`.

# Bring it back to you with `minka`.
hints: First, take {familiar} into the room from corner to corner, as before.
What your familiar sees, you see: from the room, `wizard.find_all` with `"thread"` gives the list of the pieces.

Walk that list with `for`: send your familiar to the x and the y of each piece's position and, there, have it pick the piece up with `pick_up`, which it inherited from `Familiar`. Last, `minka` brings it back with everything.
intro:
We have to help Rinlo. Let {familiar} go to the room, pick up every piece and come back to you.

Remember: being a `Familiar`, it has `pick_up` too.
outro: You have them all! … Did you hear that? A bolt, up above.
changes: The pieces are scattered all over the floor. They could be anywhere.
changed: This time, the pieces have fallen in other places in the room.
